lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb8Mg4Tl4Cl24 (Rb2MgTlCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mg and Tl centers, each coordinated by six Cl neighbors, while Rb centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Cl neighbors. The Mg- and Tl-centered octahedra share corners with one another, and face-sharing is observed between Rb 12-vertex coordination polyhedra and the Mg or Tl octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 40 sites.
